_comment: Messages of the archive bot about a page (template errors, skipped pages, errors). Used by the bot in the language of the wiki (on the talk page and in the run summary) and by the status page (web/) in the language chosen there. Placeholders: {name} as in Python's str.format; [[title]] becomes a link on the status page. Every language needs every key with the same placeholders (tests check this).

en.opt.invalid_target: '{param}' must be a page title with ((variables)), without templates, links or the characters {chars}: '{value}'.
en.opt.invalid_title: The archive page '{target}' is not a valid page title.
en.skip.protected: The page is protected, the bot may not edit it.
en.skip.self_archive: It would archive into [[{target}]]; the page seems to be an archive page itself.
en.skip.redirect: The archive page [[{target}]] redirects to a page that is not a subpage of this page.
en.skip.main_namespace: The archive page [[{target}]] is in the main namespace.
en.skip.namespace: The archive page [[{target}]] is in a namespace the bot does not archive to.
en.skip.target_conflict: Edit conflict on the archive page [[{target}]].
en.skip.origin_changed: The page was changed during the bot run; nothing was archived.
en.skip.origin_conflict: Edit conflict on this page; the sections were already copied to the archive.
en.error.too_big: The archive page [[{target}]] would exceed the maximum page size of the wiki, nothing was archived. Please start a new archive page (e.g. by changing the target parameter).
en.error.not_saved: The archive page [[{target}]] could not be saved, nothing was archived: {detail}
